clue.text: Waste material is in decline

blocks.note: first meaning: a noun for rubbish, stressed on the first syllable
second meaning: a verb, to turn something down, stressed on the second syllable

explanation.surface: A complaint that the amount of rubbish being thrown out is falling.
explanation.walkthrough: The two meanings are spelt alike but said differently: REF-use the rubbish, re-FUSE to say no.
explanation.definitionFit: As a noun it means rubbish thrown away; as a verb it means to say no to an offer.

clue.text: Impetuous artist, be quiet!

blocks.note: RA is a Royal Academician, the usual crossword artist
sh is the sound made to hush someone

explanation.surface: Telling a hot-headed painter to keep quiet.
explanation.definitionFit: Rash means acting hastily without thinking about consequences, which is what impetuous describes.

clue.text: Delightful escapes from exercise

definitions.note: the answer is a plural noun; the definition is an uncountable noun

blocks.note: fun used as an adjective means enjoyable
runs as in runs away, gets free

explanation.surface: The pleasure of skipping a workout.
explanation.walkthrough: The surface suggests avoiding exercise, but the answer is the exercise itself: charity jogging events.
explanation.definitionFit: Fun runs are informal sponsored running races for amateurs, a form of physical activity and training.

clue.text: Supports, but remains uninvolved

blocks.note: first meaning: stays loyal to someone
second meaning: watches without acting

explanation.surface: Someone who backs a cause in theory yet keeps out of the action.
explanation.walkthrough: The same phrasal verb means both to stay loyal to someone and to look on passively.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrasal verb can mean to back a friend loyally, or to watch idly while something happens without intervening.

clue.text: Disturbed, the Queen interrupts funny remarks

indicators.note: to interrupt is to break into the middle of something, so one piece sits inside another

blocks.note: cracks are jokes or witty quips
ER, Elizabeth Regina, is the usual crossword Queen

explanation.surface: A monarch, upset, cuts in on someone's jokes.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Disturbed' looks like it describes the Queen, but it is the definition, meaning mad.
explanation.definitionFit: Crackers is informal British slang for mad or crazy, which matches a mentally disturbed state.

clue.text: Art movement's sentimental: is Frenchman attached to it?

blocks.note: romantic can mean sentimental or idealised
taken as written
M is short for Monsieur, a Frenchman

explanation.surface: Asking whether a Frenchman is fond of a sentimental school of art.
explanation.definitionFit: Romanticism was the late eighteenth and early nineteenth century European cultural trend in painting, music and literature emphasising emotion.

clue.text: Church exam is performed by a choir

blocks.note: CH is the standard abbreviation for church
an oral is a spoken examination

explanation.surface: A church examination consisting of a sung performance.
explanation.definitionFit: Choral describes music written for or sung by a group of singers together.

clue.text: Titles I changed, being exclusive

indicators.note: changed means made different, so the order of these letters is altered

blocks.note: the seven letters to be rearranged

explanation.surface: A snob altered someone's honours to keep the club select.
explanation.definitionFit: Elitist describes favouring a small privileged group and shutting others out, which is what exclusive means.

clue.text: Special group with metal device for removing wrinkles

blocks.note: S is an abbreviation for special
a team is a group working together
iron is a metallic element

explanation.surface: An elite squad armed with some metal gadget that smooths out creases.
explanation.definitionFit: A steam iron presses clothes using heat and jets of vapour to smooth out creases in fabric.

clue.text: File a loan originally for footwear

indicators.note: originally points to how the word starts, so only its opening letter is used

blocks.note: to sand is to smooth with abrasive, like a file
taken as written
the first letter of loan

explanation.surface: Someone completing paperwork to borrow money for a pair of shoes.
explanation.definitionFit: A sandal is an open shoe held on by straps, a kind of footwear.

clue.text: I am active still

blocks.note: I am contracts to I'm
mobile means able to move about, active

explanation.surface: A self-contradictory boast: I am lively and yet I am not moving.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Still' reads as 'nevertheless' but it is the definition: motionless.
explanation.definitionFit: Still as an adjective means not moving at all, the same as unable to move or motionless.

clue.text: Eastman mindful, perhaps, of taking the Bible literally

indicators.note: perhaps hints that the letters given are one possible version of something else, to be reworked

blocks.note: the fourteen letters to be rearranged

explanation.surface: Wondering whether someone called Eastman is mindful of strict biblical literalism.
explanation.definitionFit: The belief system insisting on the strict literal truth of scripture is known by this name, especially in American Protestantism.

clue.text: Amphibious American soldiers remain roughly an organised body

indicators.note: roughly means not precisely, so the letters come out in an approximate order

blocks.note: the six letters to be rearranged
a corps is an organised body of people

explanation.surface: US troops who fight on land and sea stay together as a disciplined unit.
explanation.definitionFit: The US Marine Corps is the branch of American forces trained for landing operations from ships, fighting at sea and ashore.

clue.text: One-time oriental quarter of capital city

definitions.text: One-time oriental quarter of capital city

blocks.note: east is the oriental quarter of the compass
Berlin is the capital of Germany

explanation.surface: A historical note about the eastern district of a capital.
explanation.walkthrough: The whole clue is the definition, and its words also build the answer. Until 1990 the eastern part of Berlin was a separate city under Soviet control.
explanation.definitionFit: The Soviet sector of the divided German capital existed only from 1949 to 1990, hence one-time.

clue.text: Choose spoken kind of roll

blocks.note: to elect is to choose by vote
oral means spoken rather than written

explanation.surface: Picking a bread roll by naming it aloud at the counter.
explanation.walkthrough: The electoral roll is the official register of people entitled to vote.
explanation.definitionFit: An electoral roll is the official register of voters, so electoral describes that type of list.

clue.text: Celebrity in hideous tartan suit

indicators.note: in tells us the answer sits inside the following run of words

blocks.note: spans the end of the first word and the start of the second

explanation.surface: A famous person spotted wearing an ugly checked suit.
explanation.definitionFit: A star is a famous performer or public figure, a common synonym for a celebrity.

clue.text: Drunken nudities leading to split

indicators.note: a drunken person staggers about, so the letters reel into a new order

blocks.note: the eight letters to be rearranged

explanation.surface: Drunken nakedness ends in a couple breaking up.
explanation.definitionFit: To disunite is to separate or divide what was joined, which is what the verb split means.

clue.text: Real problem: how should one address a peer?

indicators.note: a problem is something gone wrong, so these letters are out of order

blocks.note: the four letters to be rearranged

explanation.surface: A worry about etiquette: what is the correct form of address for a member of the nobility?
explanation.definitionFit: An earl is a British nobleman ranking above a viscount, and every earl is a peer of the realm.

clue.text: Brushes off and polishes again

blocks.note: first meaning: snubs or rejects curtly
second meaning: re- plus buffs, rubs to a shine once more

explanation.surface: Someone cleaning a surface, wiping it down and shining it twice.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Brushes off' reads as cleaning, which fits polishing; here it means snubs.
explanation.definitionFit: To rebuff is to reject or snub someone bluntly; split as re-buffs it means shines with a cloth a second time.

clue.text: Restrain ten bearing impediment

blocks.note: to inhibit is to hold back or restrain
ten written as 10, read as the letters I and O
a bearing is a compass direction, here north

explanation.surface: An instruction to hold back ten people carrying some burden.
explanation.walkthrough: Ten is the digits 1 and 0, which look like the letters I and O.
explanation.definitionFit: An inhibition is a mental block holding someone back, which is a kind of hindrance or obstacle.

clue.text: A deceit, maybe, to get a cold drink

indicators.note: maybe hints that these letters are only one possible version, so they can be reworked

blocks.note: the seven letters to be rearranged

explanation.surface: Using a trick to obtain a chilled beverage.
explanation.definitionFit: Iced tea is tea served chilled over ice, a popular refreshing beverage in summer.

clue.text: Sound army officer at the centre of things

indicators.note: sound tells us to go by how a word is pronounced rather than spelt

blocks.note: a colonel is a senior army officer, pronounced like the seed word

explanation.surface: A dependable military commander who is always at the heart of the action.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Sound' looks like an adjective meaning reliable, but it is the homophone signal.
explanation.definitionFit: A kernel is the inner seed of a nut, and figuratively the core or essential part of anything.

clue.text: Tom put bracelet around an iPad

indicators.note: around suggests letters moved about, turned every which way

blocks.note: the fourteen letters to be rearranged

explanation.surface: Tom fastened a protective band around his Apple device.
explanation.definitionFit: Apple's iPad is the best-known example of a flat touchscreen portable computing device, so it is defined by example.

clue.text: Determination shown by leaders of Greeks rebelling in Turkey

indicators.note: leaders are those at the front, so the opening letter of each word is taken

blocks.note: the initial letters of these four words

explanation.surface: Resolve displayed by Greek insurgents rising up in Ottoman lands.
explanation.definitionFit: Grit means courage and resolve, the strength of character to keep going despite difficulty.

clue.text: Polish railway leads to plant

blocks.note: to polish something is to refine it
RY is a standard abbreviation for railway

explanation.surface: A Polish rail line runs to a factory.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Polish' seems to be the nationality thanks to its capital at the start; it is the verb to polish.
explanation.definitionFit: A refinery is an industrial installation for purifying oil or sugar, and plant is a word for such a works.

clue.text: One is disturbing the peace, as trio plays with soap from America

indicators.note: plays suggests letters performing and moving about freely

blocks.note: the four letters to be rearranged
ER was a long-running American hospital drama series

explanation.surface: A noisy group of three musicians performs along with a US TV series.
explanation.definitionFit: A rioter takes part in a violent public disturbance, so is someone breaching public order.

clue.text: No record made without enthusiasm

blocks.note: a list is a written record
the suffix -less means having none, as in the phrase no record

explanation.surface: Nobody bothered to keep a record, out of apathy.
explanation.walkthrough: The parts are read in reverse order: 'no list' becomes list-less.
explanation.definitionFit: Listless means lacking energy or interest, so someone listless acts with no zeal or drive.

clue.text: Foolish contestant ignoring cost for occupier

indicators.note: foolish means acting in a silly, disordered way, so the letters are jumbled
to ignore something is to leave it out, so some letters are dropped

blocks.note: the word as written
the letters to remove

explanation.surface: A silly game-show entrant pays no attention to the price of a flat.
explanation.walkthrough: Remove C, O, S and T from CONTESTANT, leaving NTEANT to be rearranged.
explanation.definitionFit: A tenant rents and lives in a property owned by someone else, so is its occupant.
